game: LAC @ LA, Week 8 2026, morning of kickoff / LA -6.5 / total 46 / weather not saved

script.base: Books have the Rams leading: implied team totals LA 26.2 and LAC 19.8 on a 46 total, a one-score control game rather than a shootout or a slog. LA leans on Kyren Williams late (42 carries, 198 rush yards in weeks 5-7) with Blake Corum mixed in (31/154), while Puka Nacua (41 targets, 286 yards) still has to move the chains to get to 26. LAC, down, throws more than it runs, which caps Omarion Hampton (30/96 in weeks 4-6) and the rest of a four-man rush committee.
script.flip1: Chargers hang around or lead behind Justin Herbert's designed runs and scrambles (17 carries, 120 yards in weeks 4-6). Rams never get the clock drill, Kyren's carry bump dies toward his 49- and 50-yard floors, and targets concentrate on Puka, Tyler Higbee and Davante Adams.
script.flip2: Rams pull away early. Starter snaps get cut in the fourth, Corum (a 93-yard rush game in the last four, 31 carries in three weeks) vultures garbage carries, and Puka's shot volume stalls the way his 78 and 80 rush+rec games already show.

Their passing soft spot is the middle (6.86), not the perimeter (right 5.41, left 6.03), and they have only 14 passes of 20+ for 236 yards in 7 games.
matchup.overlap: Core overlap is Puka, the Rams' primary target (41 targets, 301 air yards in three games), into the Chargers' bleeding secondary. Second overlap is Kyren's lead-back carries into a 4.34 YPC Chargers run defense in a Rams-lead script. No named corner or linebacker — charting was not saved.

Herbert last4 rush 17, 40, 54, 26 (L3 17/120, 7.1 YPC) vs a 24.5 line that matches carries times the Rams' 4.22 YPC allowed, not his raw average. Hampton L3 30/96 (3.2 YPC) while Vidal is more efficient (20/103); Hampton last4 rush 56, 45, 33, 18. Mitchell last4 rush 52, 39, 11, 4 and rush+rec 47, 63, 29, 4 — role unstable. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because a two-score Rams lead became a rotation, not a Kyren clock drill: Corum already has 31 carries and a 93-yard game in this window, and Kyren's last four includes 49 and 50. Puka's last four includes 80 and 78 when the explosives did not hit, and a 41-target role invites a bracket that feeds Higbee and Adams instead. The Chargers' 4.34 YPC and 8.02 YPA are season rates, not a charted shell, and Herbert's 17-carry scramble package can keep LAC close enough that the run script never arrives. Both leans are also priced as coin flips, so a small read error is a full loss at -110 to -114.
slip_story: One control-game story, not a shootout and not a blowout stack: Rams team total 26.2, lead of about a score. Puka rush+rec over is the first-three-quarters chain mover into the soft secondary; Kyren rush over is the late carry bump. They can win together if the lead stays modest; they need opposite things only in the blowout flip, which is tagged in kills_it. Do not add a total under, a Chargers RB over, or a TD. One market per player. Two leans only — not forced into a 3-4 leg slip. No bet placed.
